question: 列出没有任何任务的用户姓名。
gold_sql: SELECT users.name FROM users LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.user_id = users.id WHERE tasks.id IS NULL

question: 已完成的任务有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE done = 1

question: 来自 CN 的用户有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE country = 'CN'

question: 订单的平均金额是多少？
每个用户的订单总额，按用户名列出。
gold_sql: SELECT users.name, SUM(orders.amount) FROM users JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.name

question: 任务数量最多的用户名是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT users.name FROM users JOIN tasks ON tasks.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 金额大于 100 的订单数量和总额。
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE amount > 100

question: 用户分布在多少个不同的国家？
每个用户（包括没有任务的）的任务数。
gold_sql: SELECT users.name, COUNT(tasks.id) FROM users LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.user_id = users.id GROUP BY users.id

question: 没有下过订单的用户姓名。
gold_sql: SELECT users.name FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id WHERE orders.id IS NULL

question: 2026 年订单总额超过 200 的用户姓名。
gold_sql: SELECT users.name FROM users JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id WHERE orders.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND orders.created_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY users.id HAVING SUM(orders.amount) > 200
